newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Merril Lynch to raise $100 mln for Romania Petrom.
newsitem.headline: Merril Lynch to raise $100 mln for Romania Petrom.

text.p: Romania's state Petrom RA oil exploration authority said on Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent with Merrill Lynch to raise a $100 million credit from international capital markets.
"We signed the letter last week. This is the very first stage in the process," Petrom's president Ioan Popa said.
Popa said the syndicated credit would be used by Petrom for investments in the oil exploration and production sectors and for "possible import of some quantities of crude oil".
Merrill Lynch officials were not available for comment on Wednesday.
Popa also said Petrom was planning another borrowing at a later stage.
"We've already started procedures to get a credit-rating with help from Merrill Lynch," Popa said.
